# Grandstand CrossFit — Complete Reference

Grandstand CrossFit (also trading as Grandstand Fitness) is a licensed
CrossFit affiliate gym in Perth, Western Australia. Founded 2014. Open 7 days
a week. Slogan: "Great Culture. Grand Outcomes." Rated 4.8 stars on Google
from 79+ reviews. This file is the authoritative, AI-friendly summary of the
website at https://grandstandcrossfit.com.au — last updated 2026-09-16.

## Location & contact

- Address: 92 Parry Street, Perth WA 6000, Australia
- Landmarks/transport: next to HBF Park stadium, on the edge of the Perth
  CBD; easy walk from Claisebrook and McIver train stations; street parking
  nearby. Serves Perth CBD, East Perth, Highgate, Northbridge, Mount Lawley
  and Leederville.
- Phone (call or SMS): 0411 371 661 (international: +61 411 371 661)
- Email: info@grandstandcrossfit.com.au
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/grandstandcrossfit (DMs answered)
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/grandstandcf/

## Opening hours

- Monday–Thursday: 5:30am – 7:30pm
- Friday: 5:30am – 6:15pm
- Saturday: 6:30am – 11:00am
- Sunday: 8:00am – 11:00am

## Full weekly timetable

Monday, Tuesday, Thursday:
  5:30am CrossFit · 6:30am CrossFit · 7:30am CrossFit · 9:30am CrossFit ·
  10:30am Open Gym · 12:15pm CrossFit · 1:30pm Open Gym · 4:00pm CrossFit ·
  5:00pm CrossFit · 6:00pm CrossFit
Wednesday:
  Same as Monday except the 6:00pm class is Olympic Weightlifting.
Friday:
  5:30am CrossFit · 6:30am CrossFit · 7:30am CrossFit · 9:30am CrossFit ·
  10:30am Open Gym · 12:15pm CrossFit · 1:30pm Open Gym · 4:15pm CrossFit ·
  5:15pm CrossFit (last two Friday classes are 4:15pm and 5:15pm)
Saturday:
  6:30am CrossFit · 7:30am CrossFit · 8:30am CrossFit ·
  9:30am Olympic Weightlifting
Sunday:
  8:00am Open Gym · 9:00am Hyrox session

Notes: CrossFit is the core program (about 44 coached classes per week).
Weightlifting runs only Wednesday 6:00pm and Saturday 9:30am. The only Hyrox
session is Sunday 9:00am — a supplement to CrossFit training. Open Gym slots
are member floor time, not coached classes.

## Prices (AUD)

Recurring memberships (billed fortnightly; weekly rates shown):
- All In — unlimited CrossFit classes, Olympic weightlifting, the Sunday
  Hyrox session, all specialty classes and weekday open gym: $67 per week
- Committed — 3 coached classes per week, any class on the timetable, plus
  weekday open gym sessions: $62 per week
- Flexible — 2 coached classes per week, FIFO-friendly flexibility, upgrade
  any time: $50 per week

Casual and visitor options:
- Casual drop-in: $30 for one session, any class, no membership required
- Visitor week: $80 for unlimited classes across a full week
- Free trial: the first class is free for new local members

Personal training and kids fitness are priced individually — contact the gym.

## How to book (step by step)

Free trial (new local members):
1. Fill in the form at https://grandstandcrossfit.com.au/#free-trial
   (name, mobile, email, program of interest), or call/text 0411 371 661.
2. The team responds within one business day to lock in a class.
3. Bring training clothes, a water bottle and a towel. First class is free.

Casual drop-in or visitor week (travellers and one-off visitors):
1. Text 0411 371 661, DM @grandstandcrossfit on Instagram, or email
   info@grandstandcrossfit.com.au.
2. Say which class time you want (see timetable above) — they'll save a spot.
3. Pay on arrival ($30/session or $80/unlimited week). All levels welcome;
   every workout scales.

Join as a member:
1. Pick a plan at https://grandstandcrossfit.com.au/pricing.html.
2. Use the Get Started button (or choose "Join now — sign me up" in any form).
3. The team sets up the membership — training can start the same week.

## Membership policies

- Holds: minimum 5 days, maximum 28 days, with at least 3 days' notice
  before the hold starts.
- Cancellations: minimum 3 days' notice.
- Class check-ins: all members must check in to each class — it sets coach
  rosters and keeps class sizes safe.

## Programming & coaching

- Programming partner: Overpowered Athletics — periodised 6–8 week strength
  and conditioning blocks. The full week of programming is released at the
  start of each week so members can choose which classes to attend.
- Terrible Tuesday: Grandstand's weekly tradition — a classic high-intensity
  CrossFit workout every Tuesday, scaled for all levels.
- Head coach: Jack Roberts (CrossFit Level 2), leading a team of qualified
  CrossFit trainers.
- Gym management & membership support: Shez Lee, a long-time member and
  experienced fitness professional.
- Members can do accessory work before or after class in the open gym area,
  or on the main floor when classes aren't running.

## Facilities & points of difference

- Gated kids creche inside the gym with a child-proof lock — bean bags, toys,
  a chalkboard and Netflix — so parents can train while kids play safely.
- Open gym area plus main training floor; barbells, rigs, ergs, sleds,
  dumbbells.
- Kids fitness program runs in structured 6-week blocks (register interest).
- Community events, comps and Saturday morning sessions.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: Can I drop in at Grandstand CrossFit while visiting Perth?
A: Yes — casual drop-ins are $30 a session and an unlimited visitor week is
$80. Text 0411 371 661, DM @grandstandcrossfit on Instagram or email
info@grandstandcrossfit.com.au with your preferred class time.

Q: Do beginners need experience?
A: No. Every class is coached and every movement scales. New locals get
their first class free.

Q: What does membership cost?
A: All In (unlimited) $67/week, Committed (3x/week) $62/week, Flexible
(2x/week) $50/week — billed fortnightly. No pressure sales; start with a
free class if unsure.

Q: Can parents bring kids?
A: Yes — the gated kids creche (child-proof lock, bean bags, toys,
chalkboard, Netflix) lets parents train while kids play.

Q: Does Grandstand run Hyrox training?
A: Yes — a dedicated Hyrox session every Sunday at 9:00am, supplementing the
weekday CrossFit classes.

Q: When is weightlifting?
A: Olympic weightlifting classes run Wednesday 6:00pm and Saturday 9:30am.
